# Forum Fortress anti-spam plugin for MyBB

Forum Fortress helps MyBB 1.8 admins catch spam registrations, posts, edits,
profiles, signatures and contact-form submissions through its hosted anti-spam
service.

## Download and install

Get the current ZIP from the [MyBB plugin page](https://forumfortress.com/platforms/mybb/).
Upload the package files to your forum and activate the plugin in the Admin CP.
The [MyBB installation guide](https://forumfortress.com/docs/install/mybb/) explains
the directory layout, setup and troubleshooting.

The plugin is licensed under GPL-2.0-or-later. The hosted service is separate.
For help, [contact Forum Fortress](https://forumfortress.com/support/#contact).
